threads.body: The embeddings error handlers in `aws-bedrock`, `azure-ai-inference`, `azure-openai`, `cohere`, `google-genai`, `litellm`, and `mistralai` record span/metric errors but omit this event. They have access to the SDK exception details, so this leaves capturable signals uncovered under `.github/instructions/evaluate-reference.instructions.md:40`. Add SDK failure cases and correlated WARN exception logs to these scenarios, then refresh their coverage data and READMEs.

     note: >
-      This event SHOULD be recorded when an exception occurs during Generative AI client operations other than inference.
+      This event SHOULD be recorded when an exception occurs during Generative AI client operations other than inference or embeddings.
 
       For inference operations, instrumentations SHOULD record `gen_ai.client.inference.exception`
       instead of this event.
 
+      For embeddings operations, instrumentations SHOULD record `gen_ai.client.embeddings.exception`
+      instead of this event.
+
       Instrumentations SHOULD set the severity to WARN (severity number 13) when recording this event.
 
       Instrumentations MAY provide a configuration option to populate exception events
       with the attributes captured on the corresponding Generative AI client span.
     stability: development
     attributes:
       - ref_group: attributes.gen_ai.exception
+
+  - name: gen_ai.client.embeddings.exception

replies.body: Added correlated WARN exception logs to all seven existing embeddings error handlers in [ac25c1b](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/commit/ac25c1b6affa627b6ac3e3e1292136434a49b382), preserving metrics and rethrow behavior. The READMEs note that these paths aren't exercised. Keeping the existing OpenAI failure proof without adding per-library failure cases.

threads.body:
`Logger.emit` takes the exception object directly (opentelemetry-api 1.45.1), and the SDK fills `exception.type`/`message`/`stacktrace` from it. Would be nice to use it here and in the other scenarios (then `traceback` import can go too):

```suggestion
                exception=error,
```
